title: Is Wolverine World Wide (WWW) Turning Predictive AI Into a Durable Edge in Digital Customer Acquisition?
title_zh: Wolverine World Wide (WWW) 是否正在将预测人工智能转变为数字客户获取的持久优势？
summary: Earlier this month, Wolverine World Wide announced that its Merrell and Saucony brands are partnering with Yobi and Microsoft to deploy predictive behavioral AI on Microsoft Azure, aimed at improving marketing effectiveness and accelerating new customer acquisition.
summary_zh: 本月早些时候，Wolverine World Wide 宣布旗下 Merrell 和 Saucony 品牌正在与 Yobi 和 Microsoft 合作，在 Microsoft Azure 上部署预测行为人工智能，旨在提高营销效率并加速新客户获取。

title: KKR Balances Credit Fund Redemptions With PolyPeptide Deal Ambitions
title_zh: KKR 平衡信贷基金赎回与多肽交易雄心

summary_zh: KKR 的私人信贷基金正面临一波投资者赎回请求，这导致了与其他大型资产管理公司类似的提款限制。
